issues.description: Developer.monthsOfSwiftExperience has conflicting types across artifacts. The problem statement (problem_statement.md) and the template implementation (template_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift) declare monthsOfSwiftExperience as Int? but the solution implementation (solution_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift) declares monthsOfSwiftExperience as Double?. This inconsistency (Int? vs Double?) affects both the stored property and the initializer parameter and will confuse students about the expected type and how to implement methods that read/modify this property.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to use Int? for monthsOfSwiftExperience (update the property declaration and the initializer parameter to Int?), then adjust any code that increments or compares the value (e.g., swiftExperienceDescription() and attend(course:)) to work with Int. Alternatively, if fractional months are intended, update the problem statement and template to specify Double? and update the template stubs accordingly so all three artifacts match.
